items.title: Butch Cage and Robert Pete Williams Interview, 1967-05-13
items.q: No, no I don't know them. I think they're from right here in Zachary and they were at your house when I was here before.

ctx.x: He didn't, he didn't do that. No. Yeah. Did you ever hear of a man called Stack of Dollars? Oh yes I did. Well who was Stack of Dollars? I never didn't know much about him. Oh I don't know him but I heard of him. Stack of Dollars. What about Stack of Lee? Did you ever know him? I used to play that. You used to play Stack of Lee? I don't know him no. They say he was a real man. Say did you ever see Billy Cressans? No. He used to put a whole cup and sauce in his mouth and all that. I think he, he played around here…
Oh, I know who you're talking about. You know what, Clarence and now they say in Alson, don't you?
They, they in Alson down there always got to me down Scotland on 61.
